title: Star Trek With
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: STAR TREK WITH SAVE
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. 105 consistent pointers; end marker; matches original and 3 audio variants; not execution-tested
versions.unavailableReason: Incomplete, uncertain, or nonstandard captured payload; see the recovery validation. The source refers to extensions, external cassette data, machine code, or functions unavailable in the stock player.
versions.startupSource:
1  REM STAR TREK REVISED BY ANTHONY D'AGOSTA FOR THE TRS-80
2 DIMA(14)
4 PRINT@25,"STAR TRAK":PRINT:PRINT:INPUT"ARE YOU STARTING OR CONT";A$:IFA$="CONT"THEN5000
5  PRINT"THE PLAYER, AS CAPTAIN OF THE ENTERPRISE ALTERNATES"
10  PRINT"MOVES WITH THE KLINGON BATTLE CRUISER. AFTER A READOUT"
15  PRINT"OF THE RANGE AND BEARING TO THE ENEMY VESSEL, THE PLAY-"
20  PRINT"ER IS QUIERIED FOR HIS COMMAND.":PRINT" "
25  PRINT"PHASORS HAVE RANGE FROM 0 TO 5 MILLION KILOMETERS"
26  PRINT"(5E+06 KM). PHOTON TORPEDOES MAY BE USED FOR RANGES"
27  PRINT"2E+06 KM AND GREATER.":PRINT" "
30  PRINT"FOWARD PHASORS AND PHOTON TORPEDOES MAY BE USED FOR "
35  PRINT"BEARINGS 0 THRU 90 DEGREES. REAR PHASORS MAY BE USED"
